QuestInfo.name: A Truth Finally Known
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p406# of #m10003000# is about to tell me what she knows about Dr. Niora.
QuestInfo.1: I was able to learn a great deal from #p406#. Niora was a doctor of considerable skill, but in the course of practicing medicine, he'd carried out all sorts of experiments on his patients, and patients' conditions had begun worsening at his hospital with increasing frequency. Then, one day, a young girl lost her life — and that was what finally brought Niora under #p411#'s investigation. He was banished from the city and never returned. Which would mean that girl was... I suppose I'd better go see #b#p412##k again. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I met #p412# and told her everything I'd learned. It seemed she'd finally, however painfully, come to understand that Niora was never coming back to this hospital.

0.0: Alright. A deal's a deal, so here's what I know. Niora was a skilled doctor, but after he built that big hospital of his, patients started dying more and more often. Kind of strange, if you think about how good he was supposed to be.
0.1: Then, one day, a young girl lost her life, and people who knew her started raising questions, and the whole thing snowballed from there. Eventually, #p411# himself started quietly looking into it. And that's when all of his wrongdoings came to light, every bit of it.
0.2: Turns out Niora wanted more knowledge of medicine than any textbook or research could give him. Theory and research weren't enough, so he started running dangerous experiments on his patients, and as those experiments got bolder and bolder, a young girl ended up losing her life.
0.3: Once everything came out, Niora had to pay for it. He was banished from this city for good, never to return. If he ever showed his face here again, #p411# wouldn't let it slide. So you can be sure he's never coming back.
0.4: That's everything I know. That ghost at the hospital might be that girl, or it might not be, but... do you think you could go back and have a proper talk with her?

yes.0: Thanks. I really hope that ghost finds some peace.

no.0: Guess even you get spooked by ghosts, huh?

1.0: You're back. What took you so long...? More importantly... did you find out where Dr. Niora went? Please, tell me you did.
1.1: What...? Dr. Niora was the one who killed his patients with those dangerous experiments...? And because of that, he was banished... and he's never coming back...? That can't be... Dr. Niora told me he'd cure me. Ah...
1.2: So what am I supposed to do now...? Ah... my head hurts so much... Please... just let me be alone for a little while. I'm sorry...

npc.0: Niora is never coming back, that's for sure. So I think the least you can do is let that ghost know that much.
